texto: As a Data Publishing User, I want to be able to delete a dataset I have published, So that I can remove unwanted data from OpenSpending.
criterios_aceptacion:
- The Delete action is shown only on datasets owned by the logged-in Data Publishing User.
- Before deleting, a confirmation dialog shows the dataset title; nothing is deleted if the user cancels.
- After confirmation, the dataset no longer appears in search results, in the user's dataset list or in the API (the dataset URL returns 404).
- If the deletion fails, an error message is shown and the dataset remains unchanged.

texto: As a Data Publishing User, I want to know if my CSV file is valid, So that I can fix possible data issues before publishing it on Open Spending.
criterios_aceptacion:
- The validator checks that the file has a header row, the same number of columns in every row, and numeric values in the columns mapped as amounts.
- Each error is reported with its row number, column name and a short explanation.
- A valid file shows the message "File is valid" and enables the Publish button; an invalid file keeps Publish disabled.
- Files up to 50 MB are validated in less than 30 seconds.

texto: As a Data Publishing User, I want to be able to add a dataset in a Hidden state, So that I can work on a dataset before having it discoverable via OpenSpending user interfaces.
criterios_aceptacion:
- When adding a dataset, the user can choose Public or Hidden; Hidden is preselected.
- A Hidden dataset does not appear in search results, listings or embeddable visualisations for other users.
- The owner and Platform Administrators can still open a Hidden dataset from their dataset view.
- The owner can change a Hidden dataset to Public at any time, and it becomes searchable immediately.

texto: As a Data Publishing User, I want to be able to import data in Excel, in JSON and from a Google Spreadsheet, and to have my dataset update automatically as the source file changes, So that I do not have to convert data formats and OpenSpending always shows current data.
motivo_dificultad: varios objetivos entregables por separado (importar Excel, JSON y Google Sheets, y actualización automática)

texto: As a Data Consuming User, I want to share a view state as a URL to social networks, download an image of a particular view state and share that image to the social networks that support it, So that I can use and share the data I have found.
motivo_dificultad: tres funcionalidades de compartir en una sola HU

texto: As an API User, I want to be able to use metadata to get results from multiple datasets, So that I can build user experiences based on more than one dataset more easily.
motivo_dificultad: casi duplicada de otra HU del backlog (consultar varios datasets usando datos en vez de metadatos)

texto: As a Data Consuming User, I want to be able to change the display of all monetary measures across a set of currencies, So that I can understand localised amounts in non-localised figures.
As a Data Publishing User, I want to have a functioning Python Client, So that I can add data to the datastore in bulk from the command line or my own programs.

texto: As a Developer, I want to be able to customise the Brand Name and Icon, and Primary Color of all frontend Javascript apps, So that I can customise the branding for my own needs.
As a Data Publishing User, I want to know what my data needs to be able to be visualised on a map, So that I can visualise it on a map.
As a moderator, I want to create a new game by entering a name and an optional description, so that I can start inviting estimators.
criterios_aceptacion:
- The game name is required and accepts 1 to 60 characters; the description is optional and accepts up to 500 characters.
- If the name is empty or too long, an error message is shown and the game is not created.
- After creating the game, the moderator sees the game page with the invitation URL ready to copy.

texto: As a moderator, I want to export a transcript of a game as a CSV file, so that I can further process the stories and estimates.
criterios_aceptacion:
- The transcript page has an "Export as CSV" option.
- The CSV file has one row per story with the columns story, final estimate and date estimated, in the order the stories were played.
- Stories that were not estimated appear with an empty final estimate.
- The file opens correctly in a spreadsheet tool, including stories with commas or accented characters.

texto: As a participant, I want to be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see, so that I can limit the time spent discussing the estimates when I think we've talked long enough.
criterios_aceptacion:
- Any participant can start the timer; it counts down from 2:00.
- All participants see the same remaining time, with at most one second of difference.
- When the timer reaches 0:00, every participant sees the message "Time is up"; the round is not closed automatically.
- If the timer is already running, starting it again restarts it at 2:00.

texto: As a moderator, I want to create an account with my name, email address, password and username, log in with it, change my account details, delete my account and get a password reminder by email, so that I can use the application and keep my account under control.
motivo_dificultad: gestión completa de cuentas (crear, ingresar, editar, borrar y recordar contraseña) en una sola HU

texto: As a moderator, I want to import stories from a spreadsheet, copy and paste stories from a spreadsheet and browse through previous games, so that I can get started more quickly and find the game I am looking for.
motivo_dificultad: importar, pegar y navegar juegos anteriores son objetivos distintos

texto: As a participant, I want to change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed, so that I can change my mind.

texto: As a camp administrator, I want to be able to delete tasks/activities I scheduled, so that I can keep the schedule clean of unneeded activities.
criterios_aceptacion:
- Each scheduled task or activity has a Delete option visible only to camp administrators.
- Before deleting, the administrator confirms in a dialog that shows the activity name, group and date.
- After deletion, the activity disappears from the calendar and from the schedules seen by camp workers and parents.
- Activities that already took place cannot be deleted; the option is disabled with the message "Past activities are kept for records".

texto: As a parent, I want to be able to see which consent forms I have submitted, so that I can know what I still need to do.
criterios_aceptacion:
- The parent sees, for each enrolled child, the list of required consent forms.
- Each form shows its status: Submitted (with the submission date) or Pending.
- Pending forms are listed first and include a link to submit them.
- A parent only sees the forms of their own children.

texto: As a parent, I want to see which counselors are assigned to my kids, so that I can have peace of mind.
criterios_aceptacion:
- For each enrolled child, the parent sees the name and photo of the counselor assigned for the current camp week.
- If the assignment changes, the parent sees the new counselor the next time the page is loaded.
- If no counselor is assigned yet, the page shows "Counselor not assigned yet".
- Counselor phone numbers and personal email addresses are not shown.

texto: As a camp administrator, I want to store campers' emergency information and their parent/guardian's information in a database and see their medical forms, so that I can notify the necessary parties and be prepared in case of an emergency or an allergy attack.
motivo_dificultad: datos de emergencia, de padres y fichas médicas en una sola HU

texto: As a camp administrator, I want to be able to warn a camp worker who I think did his/her job inappropriate.
As a parent, I want to be able to share any photos the camp has taken of my child.
As an Agency user, I want the header information box to show updated date AND time, so that I know when it was updated.
criterios_aceptacion:
- The header information box shows the last update as date and time, for example "Updated 03/14/2018 4:05 PM".
- The time is shown in the user's local time zone, with the zone abbreviation.
- The value changes every time the submission is updated, without reloading the whole page.

texto: As an Agency user, I want to receive a more helpful file-level error when I upload a file with the wrong extension.
criterios_aceptacion:
- Only files with the .csv or .txt extension are accepted.
- If another extension is uploaded, the file is rejected before any validation runs and the message says which extension was received and which ones are accepted.
- The rejected file is not stored and does not appear in the submission history.

texto: As an agency user, I want to leave off the last 4 digits of the ZIP without an error, so that I can complete my submissions.
criterios_aceptacion:
- A ZIP code with 5 digits passes the validation without errors or warnings.
- A ZIP code with 9 digits (ZIP+4) is still accepted.
- A ZIP code with any other number of digits, or with letters, produces the existing ZIP format error.
